format: Original illustrated science documentary; conceptual future scenes and philosophical thought experiments

presenter.name: Mara
presenter.appearance: medium brown skin, chin-length dark bob, round glasses, teal field jacket, ochre shirt, dark trousers
presenter.era: modern or generic modern explanatory setting only
presenter.not: same living person surviving billion-year chronology; real scientist likeness

future_people: Distinct anonymous adults and families, cream/teal work clothes, protected engineered habitats when outside is hostile. No named immortal lineage or demonstrated future mission.
opening: Imagined last ordinary morning explicitly qualified in narration; not a forecast of one family or date.
ending: Returns to present-day shoreline, not Mara breathing on oxygen-poor future Earth.
sun: Ordinary small yellow disk during current/main-sequence and early biosphere decline examples; expanded red giant restricted to explicitly late stellar-stage illustrations. Sun does not become a core-collapse supernova.
earth_maps: Present globes may be recognizable; billion-year geography is speculative and not a map of safe countries.
visuals: Static hand-drawn 2D illustrations; no pan/zoom/shake, no top title bars or counters. Diagrams symbolic and not to scale, no numerical fake data.
epochs: Ancient Earth has no humans, trees or dinosaurs unless appropriate; microbial-era illustrations use rock/ocean/haze without modern organisms.
distant_technologies: Sunshade, orbital change, constructed habitats and migration shown as proposals or hypothetical examples, not flight-validated hardware or existing rescue programs.
